title: ART: Adaptive Reasoning Trees for Explainable Claim Verification

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing claim verification performance between a Single-LLM setup (where the same model generates arguments and judges them) and a Multi-LLM setup (where generation and adjudication are separated) to demonstrate the reduction of the model's bias towards its own outputs.

Evaluating the accuracy and variance of claim predictions when using isolated absolute strength calculations versus pairwise comparative ranking calibrated via the Bradley-Terry model to mitigate inconsistent scaling and prompt sensitivities in LLM judges.
